verdict.rationale: Greenhouse exposes APIs (Harvest API, Job Board API, webhooks) that allow programmatic retrieval of candidate, job, and reporting data in JSON, which could support data extraction, but there is no explicit documentation of a full account data export or 'take your data and leave' capability, and probes for OpenAPI specs and docs failed. missing for 10: explicit bulk/full-account data export feature, documented open-format export of all data types, evidence of data portability upon account closure.
